entities.summary: The Haji Alakbar Mosque, also spelt as Haji Alekber Mosque, was a Shia Islam mosque located in Fuzuli, Azerbaijan. Completed in 1890 by Karbalayi Safikhan Karabakhi, a renowned architect, the mosque was subsequently destroyed, most likely by Armenian militias in the 1990s.
